name: Elara Voss
notes: A resilient survivor who led her people away from the destruction of the island of Lund. To stabilize the catastrophic double resonance of the stones, she and Korran shared a fully clothed, highly focused meditative Yab Yum ritual, resulting in the birth of her marked 'bridge-child.'
sources: Resonant Hearts: Intimate Chronicles Aboard the Kelpfang
